description: Consumer loan underwriting: hard declines, referrals to an underwriter, approval by risk grade. Omit loan.collateralValue for an unsecured loan. Estimated instalment = amount * (1 + 1% * termMonths) / termMonths.

rules.description: Bad debt (credit bureau group 3 to 5) in the last 5 years
Minimum income; also guarantees monthlyIncome > 0 for the ratios below
6 to 60 months unsecured, 6 to 84 months secured; also guarantees termMonths > 0
Debt-to-income above 60%, including the new loan's estimated instalment
rules.when: applicant.existingMonthlyDebt + loan.amount * (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths) / loan.termMonths > applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.6')
applicant.existingMonthlyDebt + loan.amount * (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths) / loan.termMonths > applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.45')

rules.description: Less than 12 months in the current job, or 24 months for the self-employed
Base rate 8.5%; rate adds 5% x DTI and takes 2% off when secured; limit keeps DTI within 45% and LTV within 70%
rules.when: applicant.creditScore >= 750 && applicant.existingMonthlyDebt + loan.amount * (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths) / loan.termMonths <= applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.3')

then.interestRate: (decimal('0.085') + (applicant.existingMonthlyDebt + loan.amount * (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths) / loan.termMonths) / applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.05') - (has(loan.collateralValue) ? decimal('0.02') : decimal(0))).round(4, 'HALF_UP')
then.maxAmount: ((has(loan.collateralValue) ? min((applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.45') - applicant.existingMonthlyDebt) * loan.termMonths / (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths), loan.collateralValue * decimal('0.7')) : (applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.45') - applicant.existingMonthlyDebt) * loan.termMonths / (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths)) / 1000000).round(0, 'FLOOR') * 1000000

then.interestRate: (decimal('0.105') + (applicant.existingMonthlyDebt + loan.amount * (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths) / loan.termMonths) / applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.05') - (has(loan.collateralValue) ? decimal('0.02') : decimal(0))).round(4, 'HALF_UP')
then.maxAmount: ((has(loan.collateralValue) ? min((applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.45') - applicant.existingMonthlyDebt) * loan.termMonths / (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths), loan.collateralValue * decimal('0.7')) : (applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.45') - applicant.existingMonthlyDebt) * loan.termMonths / (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths)) / 1000000).round(0, 'FLOOR') * 1000000

then.interestRate: (decimal('0.13') + (applicant.existingMonthlyDebt + loan.amount * (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths) / loan.termMonths) / applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.05') - (has(loan.collateralValue) ? decimal('0.02') : decimal(0))).round(4, 'HALF_UP')
then.maxAmount: ((has(loan.collateralValue) ? min((applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.45') - applicant.existingMonthlyDebt) * loan.termMonths / (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths), loan.collateralValue * decimal('0.7')) : (applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.45') - applicant.existingMonthlyDebt) * loan.termMonths / (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths)) / 1000000).round(0, 'FLOOR') * 1000000

rules.description: Grade D is approved only with collateral; base rate 16%

then.interestRate: (decimal('0.16') + (applicant.existingMonthlyDebt + loan.amount * (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths) / loan.termMonths) / applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.05') - decimal('0.02')).round(4, 'HALF_UP')
then.maxAmount: (min((applicant.monthlyIncome * decimal('0.45') - applicant.existingMonthlyDebt) * loan.termMonths / (decimal(1) + decimal('0.01') * loan.termMonths), loan.collateralValue * decimal('0.7')) / 1000000).round(0, 'FLOOR') * 1000000

rules.description: Catch-all: credit score 500 to 559, and anything the rules above do not cover
